Landing.metaTitle: Tepati: a study promise kept by two
Landing.metaDescription: A study contract between friends: send proof before the cutoff, and every missed day becomes a line in the coin book. Coins are only a record; no money passes through the app.
Landing.heroTitle: A study promise kept by two.
Landing.heroBody: You and a friend sign a daily contract. The doer sends proof of studying before the cutoff, the backer reviews it, and every missed day becomes one line in the coin book.
Landing.money: Coins are only a record of a promise between friends. No money passes through Tepati: when the contract ends, you settle up yourselves, outside the app.
Landing.sampleNote: Example data, not real users. Sari puts in 1,000 coins as the backer and commits Monday to Friday; Bima sends proof Monday to Saturday. Today is Friday the 16th.
Landing.sampleCalendar: October 2026 calendar, with each day's status for Bima and Sari
Landing.stepFirstBody: You both sign the terms: which days count, what proof is enough, the penalty for each missed day, and the cutoff.
Landing.stepDailyBody: The doer sends proof of studying (text, photo, video or a link) before the cutoff. There is a grace period you agree on.
Landing.stepReviewBody: The backer approves or rejects, with a reason. If the backer stays silent until the review deadline, the proof is approved automatically.
Landing.stepLastBody: The final balance is recorded. The backer pays the doer outside the app, and the doer confirms the money arrived.
Landing.ruleOwnBody: The reviewer is always the other person in the contract.
Landing.ruleDisputeBody: The doer can object. The backer decides, in writing, and an objection that is not decided in time goes to the doer.
Landing.ruleOverrideBody: The backer can only reverse an automatic approval, with a written reason, at most as many times as you agreed. Every override is recorded and visible to both of you.
Landing.ruleRestBody: The doer has an agreed number of rest days. A rest day does not count and costs nothing.
Landing.rulePotBody: The pot cannot fall below the floor you set, and it can be given a ceiling.
Landing.ruleBookBody: Every coin that moves is one dated line tied to one day and one decision. Lines are never edited or deleted.
Landing.closeBody: Create an account, set the terms, then send your friend an invitation.
